changelog:
- Initial release of donad-skill as a CLI template tool under the name "skill-template"
- Provides commands for initializing, adding, removing, listing, searching, and exporting data entries
- Records all commands in a history log for auditing
- Stores data in a user-configurable directory (default: ~/.local/share/skill-template/)
- No external dependencies; uses standard Unix utilities only
- Includes sample usage and workflow guidelines for quick setup and data management
summary: OpenClaw Skill template generator. Create skill scaffolds, validate structure, enhance SKILL.md, generate command frameworks, tips, publish checklists.
